claim: UKMTO or JMIC reports at least one attack, explosion, mine strike, projectile or drone hit, armed hostile approach, boarding or seizure involving a merchant vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, the Persian Gulf, the Gulf of Oman or the Arabian Sea that took place on Wednesday 25 November 2026 (00:00-23:59 Gulf time).

runs.yes_requires: UKMTO or JMIC must report at least one qualifying maritime incident (an attack, explosion, mine strike, projectile or drone hit, hostile approach with weapons fire or boarding attempt, boarding, hijacking, or seizure) involving a merchant vessel in the Strait of Hormuz, Persian Gulf, Gulf of Oman, or Arabian Sea (including around Socotra) that occurred on 25 November 2026 between 00:00 and 23:59 G
runs.decided_by: Reports by UKMTO or JMIC published on ukmto.org, UKMTO's X account, or quoted by specified and established news outlets.

runs.scenario: If a qualifying incident is reported at 23:59:30 Gulf Standard Time, one reader could count it because '00:00–23:59' ordinarily includes the entire final minute of the day, while another could exclude it because the explicit event window ends at 23:59:00.
